agent_handoff.gather: Collected 5 Smart Money netflow candidates and 5 buyer/seller rows.
agent_handoff.movement: Compared 7-day netflow, buyer/seller volume, top-holder concentration, and daily OHLCV for the selected token.
agent_handoff.brain: Use netflow direction, trader breadth, holder concentration, and price response to create game suspects.
agent_handoff.judge: Prefer tokens where smart money movement and holder behavior disagree with price or crowd behavior.
agent_handoff.risk: Avoid over-weighting a single whale or holder row unless buyer/seller and OHLCV evidence confirms it.
